journey.name: applying toast close button
journey.description:
A toast that does not hide by itself shows a close X at its top right, and its text never runs under that X. The "Applying changes…" toast shown while the address type changes is one, on both platforms. French at the largest text size makes its title ("Application des modifications…") fill the first line, so it has to wrap before the X instead of continuing beneath it.
Precondition: onboarded dev wallet, start on the wallet home screen. The toast stays only while the change applies, usually one or two seconds, so take the screenshot right after the tap and repeat the switch if it was missed. Toasts are not in `android layout` or `snapshot-ui`, so the checks read a screenshot.
Android: set French with `adb shell cmd locale set-app-locales to.bitkit.dev --locales fr` and the text size with `adb shell settings put system font_scale 2.0`. iOS: set French in the app's language settings and the text size with `xcrun simctl ui booted content_size accessibility-extra-extra-extra-large`.

actions.action: Set the app language to French and the text size to the largest value
Tap the menu button (tag "HeaderMenu") and tap Settings
Tap the Advanced tab (tag "Tab-advanced") and tap Address Type (tag "AddressTypePreference")
Tap the address type that is not selected among Native Segwit (tag "p2wpkh") and Taproot (tag "p2tr"), and take a screenshot right away
Verify from the screenshot that the toast titled "Application des modifications…" shows a close X at its top right and no part of its text is drawn under or to the right of the left edge of the X
Tap the address type that was selected at the start, to restore it
Restore the app language and the default text size
